HediffDef.label: Flayer virus
HediffDef.description: The Flayer curse — an echo of the slain C'tan Llandu'gor — gnaws at the mind and lattice alike. Afflicted units hunger for organic matter they can never digest, drape themselves in trophy-flesh, and slip unpredictably through the Ghostwind between moments. The necrodermis still knits damage closed, but every repair feeds the hunger.\n\nCombat protocols exploit dimensional bleed: a short-lived veil that breaks weapon locks and sightlines, as Crypteks once catalogued among fully turned Flayed Ones.

HediffDef.label: ghostwind
HediffDef.description: This pawn is out of phase with the normal world — ranged weapons and sensors struggle to target it.\n\nThose afflicted with the Flayer Virus develop the ability to "tunnel" through reality and inhabit a sub-dimension known as the Ghostwind.
